<!-- ============================================================
     INFOGRAFÍAS DE ARANCELES (ggplot2 + patchwork)
     1) Pegue el bloque "setup-infografias" UNA sola vez, antes del primer gráfico.
     2) Cada sección (gráfico + tabla de hitos + fuentes) es independiente.
     Requiere: ggplot2, patchwork, knitr (y ragg para el PNG).
     ============================================================ -->

```{r}
#| label: setup-infografias
#| include: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)

# ---- Paleta (de las infografías HTML) -------------------------------------
pal <- c(bg = "#FFFFFF", ink = "#141F2B", ink2 = "#4C5661", ink3 = "#7A8189",
         line = "#CCD0C4", gold = "#B87A1E", fenta = "#7A4A21", green = "#2F7C4A",
         plum = "#9C4177", crimson = "#A23327")

wrap_txt <- function(x, n) paste(strwrap(x, width = n), collapse = "\n")
n_lines  <- function(x) lengths(regmatches(x, gregexpr("\n", x))) + 1

# ---- Título alineado con la franja ---------------------------------------
panel_titulo <- function(sp) {
  tt <- sp$title
  fs <- min(15, 6.2 / (sum(nchar(tt$txt)) * 0.0078))
  gp <- function(col) grid::gpar(fontsize = fs, fontface = "bold", col = col)
  grobs <- list(); prev <- grid::unit(0, "npc")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(tt))) {
    grobs[[i]] <- grid::textGrob(tt$txt[i], x = prev, y = 0.5, hjust = 0,
                                 gp = gp(pal[[tt$col[i]]]))
    prev <- prev + grid::grobWidth(grid::textGrob(tt$txt[i], gp = gp("black")))
  }
  ggplot() +
    annotation_custom(do.call(grid::gTree, list(children = do.call(grid::gList, grobs)))) +
    theme_void()
}

# ---- Franja de cifras clave ----------------------------------------------
panel_cifras <- function(sp) {
  st <- sp$stats; k <- nrow(st); st$i <- seq_len(k) - 1
  ggplot(st) +
    annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = k, y = 1, yend = 1, colour = pal[["ink"]], linewidth = 0.9) +
    annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = k, y = 0.02, yend = 0.02, colour = pal[["ink3"]], linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_segment(data = data.frame(x = seq_len(k - 1)), aes(x = x, xend = x, y = 0.12, yend = 0.92),
                 colour = pal[["line"]], linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(aes(x = i + 0.03, y = 0.84, colour = pal[col]), shape = 15, size = 1.3) +
    geom_text(aes(x = i + 0.07, y = 0.84, label = lab), hjust = 0, size = 1.8,
              colour = pal[["ink2"]], fontface = "bold") +
    geom_text(aes(x = i + 0.03, y = 0.55, label = num), hjust = 0, size = 5.6,
              colour = pal[["ink"]], fontface = "bold") +
    geom_text(aes(x = i + 0.03, y = 0.30, label = sub), hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
              size = 1.9, colour = pal[["ink2"]]) +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, k), ylim = c(-0.25, 1), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
    theme_void()
}

# ---- Leyenda (se acomoda en filas) ---------------------------------------
sym_lab <- c(cambio = "cambio de tasa", hito = "hito sin cambio de tasa",
             amenaza = "amenaza no vigente", fallo = "fallo judicial")
panel_leyenda <- function(sp) {
  cw <- 0.78                               # unidades (de 100) por caracter
  it <- rbind(
    data.frame(kind = "line", key = sp$leg_lines$col, lab = sp$leg_lines$lab, grp = 1),
    data.frame(kind = "sym",  key = sp$leg_syms, lab = sym_lab[sp$leg_syms], grp = 2))
  it$w <- ifelse(it$kind == "line", 5.5, 3) + nchar(it$lab) * cw + 4
  x <- 0; r <- 1; it$x <- NA; it$r <- NA
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(it))) {
    if (i > 1 && (it$grp[i] != it$grp[i - 1] || x + it$w[i] > 100)) { r <- r + 1; x <- 0 }
    it$x[i] <- x; it$r[i] <- r; x <- x + it$w[i]
  }
  nr <- max(it$r); it$y <- nr - it$r + 0.5
  L <- subset(it, kind == "line"); S <- subset(it, kind == "sym")
  p <- ggplot() +
    annotate("segment", x = L$x, xend = L$x + 4, y = L$y, yend = L$y,
             colour = pal[L$key], linewidth = 1.3) +
    annotate("text", x = L$x + 5, y = L$y, label = L$lab, hjust = 0, size = 2.3, colour = pal[["ink2"]])
  sx <- S$x + 1; sy <- S$y
  if (any(S$key == "cambio"))  p <- p + annotate("point", x = sx[S$key == "cambio"],  y = sy[S$key == "cambio"],  shape = 16, size = 2, colour = pal[["ink2"]])
  if (any(S$key == "hito"))    p <- p + annotate("point", x = sx[S$key == "hito"],    y = sy[S$key == "hito"],    shape = 21, size = 2, fill = "white", colour = pal[["ink3"]], stroke = 0.9)
  if (any(S$key == "amenaza")) p <- p + annotate("point", x = sx[S$key == "amenaza"], y = sy[S$key == "amenaza"], shape = 24, size = 2, fill = "white", colour = pal[["crimson"]], stroke = 0.8)
  if (any(S$key == "fallo"))   p <- p + annotate("point", x = sx[S$key == "fallo"],   y = sy[S$key == "fallo"],   shape = 4, size = 1.8, colour = pal[["crimson"]], stroke = 1)
  p <- p + annotate("text", x = S$x + 3, y = S$y, label = S$lab, hjust = 0, size = 2.3, colour = pal[["ink2"]]) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, nr), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
    theme_void()
  attr(p, "filas") <- nr
  p
}

# ---- Serie principal ------------------------------------------------------
panel_serie <- function(sp, h_in = 3.75) {
  ev <- sp$events; n <- nrow(ev); mk <- sp$marks
  banda <- isTRUE(sp$notas_banda)
  ymax <- max(sp$ticks)
  pan_h <- h_in - 0.45                                  # alto aprox. del panel (pulgadas)
  ytop <- ymax / (1 - 0.42 / pan_h)                     # 0.42 in de holgura sobre la marca superior
  ymin <- if (banda) -0.16 * ytop else 0
  u <- (ytop - ymin) / pan_h                            # unidades de datos por pulgada
  # --- etiquetas de tasa
  lab <- subset(mk, !is.na(lab))
  seg_v <- subset(sp$segs, x == xend)
  lab$desde_arriba <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(lab)), function(i) {
    v <- subset(seg_v, abs(x - lab$x[i]) < 1e-6)
    any(pmax(v$y, v$yend) > lab$y[i] + 1e-6 & (abs(v$y - lab$y[i]) < 1e-6 | abs(v$yend - lab$y[i]) < 1e-6))
  }, logical(1))
  izq <- lab$labpos == "above" & lab$desde_arriba          # etiqueta a la izquierda del marcador
  lab$ly <- ifelse(izq, lab$y, lab$y + ifelse(lab$labpos == "above", 0.23, -0.10) * u)
  lab$vj <- ifelse(izq, 0.5, ifelse(lab$labpos == "above", 0.5, 1))
  lab$hj <- ifelse(izq, 1, 0.5)
  lab$lx <- ifelse(izq, lab$x - 0.12, lab$x)
  # --- notas
  nt <- data.frame(x = mk$x, y = mk$y, nota = ev$nota, lab = !is.na(mk$lab),
                   labpos = mk$labpos)
  nt$arriba <- vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
    v <- subset(seg_v, abs(x - i) < 1e-6)
    any(pmin(v$y, v$yend) < mk$y[i] - 1e-6 & (abs(v$y - mk$y[i]) < 1e-6 | abs(v$yend - mk$y[i]) < 1e-6))
  }, logical(1))
  if (banda) {
    nt$ny <- -0.025 * ytop; nt$vj <- 1
  } else {
    below <- !nt$arriba
    avail <- (nt$y - ymin) / u - 0.30
    gap   <- pmin(0.55, pmax(0.25, avail))
    nt$ny <- ifelse(below, nt$y - gap * u,
                    nt$y + ifelse(nt$lab & nt$labpos == "above", 0.34, 0.14) * u)
    nt$vj <- ifelse(below, 1, 0)
  }
  trazos <- sp$segs; trazos$hex <- pal[trazos$col]
  mk$hex <- pal[mk$col]
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_segment(data = trazos, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, colour = hex),
                 linewidth = 1.6, lineend = "square") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = n + 0.6, linetype = "22", colour = pal[["ink3"]], linewidth = 0.4) +
    annotate("text", x = n + 0.6, y = ytop * 0.975, label = "hoy", size = 2.2, colour = pal[["ink3"]]) +
    geom_point(data = subset(mk, tipo == "amenaza"), aes(x, y), shape = 24, size = 3.2,
               fill = "white", colour = pal[["crimson"]], stroke = 0.9) +
    geom_point(data = subset(mk, tipo == "hito"), aes(x, y), shape = 21, size = 2.8,
               fill = "white", colour = pal[["ink3"]], stroke = 0.9) +
    geom_point(data = subset(mk, tipo == "fallo"), aes(x, y), shape = 4, size = 3,
               colour = pal[["crimson"]], stroke = 1.3) +
    geom_point(data = subset(mk, tipo == "cambio"), aes(x, y, fill = hex, colour = hex),
               shape = 21, size = 3.2) +
    geom_text(data = lab, aes(lx, ly, label = lab, colour = pal[ifelse(col == "crimson", "gold", col)], vjust = vj, hjust = hj), size = 3.4, fontface = "bold") +
    geom_text(data = nt, aes(x, ny, label = nota, vjust = vj), size = if (n > 9) 1.9 else 2.0,
              colour = pal[["ink2"]], lineheight = 0.9) +
    scale_colour_identity() + scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_len(n), labels = sub(" (\\d{4})$", "\n\\1", ev$fecha),
                       limits = c(0.5, n + 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = sp$ticks, labels = function(v) paste0(v, "%"),
                       limits = c(ymin, ytop), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = sp$ytitle) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = pal[["line"]], linetype = "13", linewidth = 0.4),
          axis.text.x = element_text(colour = pal[["ink"]], size = if (n > 9) 6 else 6.5, lineheight = 0.9),
          axis.text.y = element_text(colour = pal[["ink3"]], size = 7),
          axis.title.y = element_text(colour = pal[["ink3"]], size = 6.5),
          axis.line.x = if (banda) element_blank() else element_line(colour = pal[["ink2"]], linewidth = 0.5))
  if (banda) p <- p + annotate("segment", x = 0.5, xend = n + 1, y = 0, yend = 0,
                               colour = pal[["ink2"]], linewidth = 0.5)
  p
}

# ---- Recuadro informativo -------------------------------------------------
panel_nota <- function(sp) {
  cols <- sp$foot
  cols <- lapply(cols, function(cc) list(
    h = wrap_txt(cc$h, 42), p = paste(vapply(cc$p, wrap_txt, "", n = 56), collapse = "\n\n")))
  hh <- vapply(cols, function(cc) 0.13 + n_lines(cc$h) * 0.16 + 0.05 + n_lines(cc$p) * 0.118 + 0.12, 0)
  H <- max(hh)
  p <- ggplot() +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 100, ymin = 0, ymax = H, fill = "#FBFBF8",
             colour = pal[["ink3"]], linewidth = 0.3) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 0.9, ymin = 0, ymax = H, fill = pal[["gold"]], colour = NA)
  xs <- c(3, 53)
  for (i in seq_along(cols)) {
    p <- p +
      annotate("text", x = xs[i], y = H - 0.13, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.9, fontface = "bold",
               lineheight = 0.95, colour = if (i == 1) pal[["gold"]] else pal[["ink"]], label = cols[[i]]$h) +
      annotate("text", x = xs[i], y = H - 0.13 - n_lines(cols[[i]]$h) * 0.16 - 0.05, hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
               size = 2.3, lineheight = 1.05, colour = pal[["ink2"]], label = cols[[i]]$p)
  }
  p <- p + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, H), expand = FALSE) + theme_void()
  attr(p, "alto") <- H
  p
}

# ---- Figura completa ------------------------------------------------------
infografia <- function(sp, h_main = 3.75) {
  pl <- panel_leyenda(sp); pn <- panel_nota(sp)
  hts <- c(0.35, 0.85, attr(pl, "filas") * 0.17 + 0.10, h_main, attr(pn, "alto"))
  fig <- (panel_titulo(sp) / panel_cifras(sp) / pl / panel_serie(sp, h_main) / pn) +
    plot_layout(heights = hts)
  attr(fig, "alto_total") <- sum(hts)
  fig
}

fuentes_md <- function(sp) cat("*Fuentes:*", sp$fuentes, "\n")

tabla_hitos <- function(sp, caption) {
  kable(data.frame(Fecha = sp$events$fecha, Hito = sp$events$texto),
        format = "pipe", align = c("l", "l"), caption = caption)
}

# ---- Comparativos "pendiente": Panel A (impacto inicial) y Panel B (alivio negociado)
col_pais <- c(japon = "#B8871E", corea = "#1F6FA8", ue = "#A23327", mx30 = "#5B8A3A", mx40 = "#8A3B7A", mx = "#5B8A3A")

panel_slope <- function(sp, h_in = 4.1) {
  s <- sp$series; ns <- nrow(s)
  xA0 <- 165; xA1 <- 275; xB0 <- 307; xB1 <- 417
  ytop <- 27.5; ybot <- -13
  s$hex <- col_pais[s$id]
  s$lt  <- ifelse(s$dash, "dashed", "solid")
  rg <- rbind(
    data.frame(x = xA0, xend = xA1, y = s$a0, yend = s$a1, hex = s$hex, lt = s$lt, id = s$id),
    data.frame(x = xB0, xend = xB1, y = s$b0, yend = s$b1, hex = s$hex, lt = s$lt, id = s$id))
  pts <- rbind(data.frame(x = xA0, y = s$a0, hex = s$hex), data.frame(x = xA1, y = s$a1, hex = s$hex),
               data.frame(x = xB0, y = s$b0, hex = s$hex), data.frame(x = xB1, y = s$b1, hex = s$hex))
  ticks <- seq(0, 25, 5)
  p <- ggplot() +
    annotate("segment", x = 160, xend = xB1, y = ticks, yend = ticks, colour = pal[["line"]],
             linetype = "13", linewidth = 0.4) +
    annotate("text", x = 156, y = ticks, label = paste0(ticks, "%"), hjust = 1, size = 2.2,
             colour = pal[["ink3"]]) +
    annotate("segment", x = c(xA0, xB0), xend = c(xA1, xB1), y = 0, yend = 0, colour = pal[["ink3"]], linewidth = 0.4) +
    annotate("text", x = c((xA0 + xA1) / 2, (xB0 + xB1) / 2), y = 26.8, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.4, fontface = "bold",
             colour = pal[["ink2"]], label = c("PANEL A — impacto inicial", "PANEL B — alivio negociado")) +
    annotate("text", x = c(xA0, xA1, xB0, xB1), y = c(-1.0, -1.0, -1.0, -1.0), vjust = 1, size = 1.9,
             colour = pal[["ink2"]], lineheight = 0.9,
             hjust = c(0, 1, 0, 1), label = sp$xlab) +
    geom_segment(data = rg, aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend, colour = hex, linetype = lt),
                 linewidth = 1.0) +
    geom_point(data = pts, aes(x, y, colour = hex), size = 1.6)
  # etiquetas izquierda
  L <- s
  p <- p +
    annotate("text", x = xA0 - 8, y = L$ll + 0.55, label = L$nombre, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.1,
             fontface = "bold", colour = L$hex) +
    annotate("text", x = xA0 - 8, y = L$ll - 0.75, label = L$vini, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.0,
             colour = pal[["ink3"]])
  Ll <- subset(L, lead_l)
  if (nrow(Ll)) p <- p + annotate("segment", x = xA0 - 5, xend = xA0 - 1, y = Ll$ll + 0.6, yend = Ll$a0,
                                  colour = Ll$hex, linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "13", alpha = 0.6)
  # etiquetas derecha
  p <- p +
    annotate("text", x = xB1 + 10, y = L$lr + 0.55, label = L$rtxt, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.1,
             fontface = "bold", colour = L$hex) +
    annotate("text", x = xB1 + 10, y = L$lr - 0.75, label = L$rsub, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.0,
             colour = pal[["ink3"]])
  Lr <- subset(L, lead_r)
  if (nrow(Lr)) p <- p + annotate("segment", x = xB1 + 7, xend = xB1 + 1, y = Lr$lr, yend = Lr$b1,
                                  colour = Lr$hex, linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "13", alpha = 0.6)
  p +
    scale_colour_identity() + scale_linetype_identity() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 650), ylim = c(ybot, ytop), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
    theme_void()
}

leyenda_slope <- function(sp) {
  s <- sp$series; cw <- 0.78
  s$w <- 5.5 + nchar(s$leg) * cw + 4
  x <- 0; r <- 1; s$x <- NA; s$r <- NA
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(s))) {
    if (i > 1 && x + s$w[i] > 100) { r <- r + 1; x <- 0 }
    s$x[i] <- x; s$r[i] <- r; x <- x + s$w[i]
  }
  nr <- max(s$r); s$y <- nr - s$r + 0.5; s$hex <- col_pais[s$id]
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_segment(data = s, aes(x = x, xend = x + 4, y = y, yend = y, colour = hex,
                               linetype = ifelse(dash, "dashed", "solid")), linewidth = 1.3) +
    geom_text(data = s, aes(x = x + 5, y = y, label = leg), hjust = 0, size = 2.3, colour = pal[["ink2"]]) +
    scale_colour_identity() + scale_linetype_identity() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, nr), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") + theme_void()
  attr(p, "filas") <- nr
  p
}

panel_titulo_sl <- function(sp) {
  tt <- paste(strwrap(sp$title, 62), collapse = "\n")
  sub <- paste(strwrap(sp$subtitle, 112), collapse = "\n")
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 1, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, label = tt, size = 4.6, fontface = "bold",
             colour = pal[["ink"]], lineheight = 0.95) +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, label = sub, size = 2.2, colour = pal[["ink2"]], lineheight = 1.0) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, 1), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") + theme_void()
}

panel_nota_sl <- function(sp) {
  txt <- vapply(sp$foot, function(f) paste0(wrap_txt(f$h, 128), "\n", wrap_txt(f$p, 128)), "")
  nl <- sum(n_lines(txt)) + 0.9 * length(txt)
  H <- 0.28 + nl * 0.118
  yy <- H - 0.14
  p <- ggplot() +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 100, ymin = 0, ymax = H, fill = "#FBFBF8", colour = pal[["ink3"]], linewidth = 0.3) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 0.9, ymin = 0, ymax = H, fill = "#B8871E", colour = NA)
  for (i in seq_along(sp$foot)) {
    f <- sp$foot[[i]]; hh <- wrap_txt(f$h, 128); pp <- wrap_txt(f$p, 128)
    p <- p + annotate("text", x = 3, y = yy, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.5, fontface = "bold", colour = pal[["ink"]], label = hh) +
      annotate("text", x = 3, y = yy - 0.14, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.3, lineheight = 1.05, colour = pal[["ink2"]], label = pp)
    yy <- yy - 0.14 - n_lines(pp) * 0.118 - 0.13
  }
  p <- p + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, H), expand = FALSE) + theme_void()
  attr(p, "alto") <- H
  p
}

comparativo <- function(sp, h_main = 4.1) {
  pl <- leyenda_slope(sp); pn <- panel_nota_sl(sp)
  hts <- c(0.62, attr(pl, "filas") * 0.17 + 0.10, h_main, attr(pn, "alto"))
  fig <- (panel_titulo_sl(sp) / pl / panel_slope(sp, h_main) / pn) + plot_layout(heights = hts)
  attr(fig, "alto_total") <- sum(hts)
  fig
}

# ---- Comparativos "pendiente": Panel A (impacto inicial) y Panel B (alivio negociado)
col_pais <- c(japon = "#B8871E", corea = "#1F6FA8", ue = "#A23327", mx30 = "#5B8A3A", mx40 = "#8A3B7A", mx = "#5B8A3A")

panel_slope <- function(sp, h_in = 4.1) {
  s <- sp$series; ns <- nrow(s)
  xA0 <- 165; xA1 <- 275; xB0 <- 307; xB1 <- 417
  ytop <- 27.5; ybot <- -13
  s$hex <- col_pais[s$id]
  s$lt  <- ifelse(s$dash, "dashed", "solid")
  rg <- rbind(
    data.frame(x = xA0, xend = xA1, y = s$a0, yend = s$a1, hex = s$hex, lt = s$lt, id = s$id),
    data.frame(x = xB0, xend = xB1, y = s$b0, yend = s$b1, hex = s$hex, lt = s$lt, id = s$id))
  pts <- rbind(data.frame(x = xA0, y = s$a0, hex = s$hex), data.frame(x = xA1, y = s$a1, hex = s$hex),
               data.frame(x = xB0, y = s$b0, hex = s$hex), data.frame(x = xB1, y = s$b1, hex = s$hex))
  ticks <- seq(0, 25, 5)
  p <- ggplot() +
    annotate("segment", x = 160, xend = xB1, y = ticks, yend = ticks, colour = pal[["line"]],
             linetype = "13", linewidth = 0.4) +
    annotate("text", x = 156, y = ticks, label = paste0(ticks, "%"), hjust = 1, size = 2.2,
             colour = pal[["ink3"]]) +
    annotate("segment", x = c(xA0, xB0), xend = c(xA1, xB1), y = 0, yend = 0, colour = pal[["ink3"]], linewidth = 0.4) +
    annotate("text", x = c((xA0 + xA1) / 2, (xB0 + xB1) / 2), y = 26.8, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.4, fontface = "bold",
             colour = pal[["ink2"]], label = c("PANEL A — impacto inicial", "PANEL B — alivio negociado")) +
    annotate("text", x = c(xA0, xA1, xB0, xB1), y = c(-1.0, -1.0, -1.0, -1.0), vjust = 1, size = 1.9,
             colour = pal[["ink2"]], lineheight = 0.9,
             hjust = c(0, 1, 0, 1), label = sp$xlab) +
    geom_segment(data = rg, aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend, colour = hex, linetype = lt),
                 linewidth = 1.0) +
    geom_point(data = pts, aes(x, y, colour = hex), size = 1.6)
  # etiquetas izquierda
  L <- s
  p <- p +
    annotate("text", x = xA0 - 8, y = L$ll + 0.55, label = L$nombre, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.1,
             fontface = "bold", colour = L$hex) +
    annotate("text", x = xA0 - 8, y = L$ll - 0.75, label = L$vini, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.0,
             colour = pal[["ink3"]])
  Ll <- subset(L, lead_l)
  if (nrow(Ll)) p <- p + annotate("segment", x = xA0 - 5, xend = xA0 - 1, y = Ll$ll + 0.6, yend = Ll$a0,
                                  colour = Ll$hex, linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "13", alpha = 0.6)
  # etiquetas derecha
  p <- p +
    annotate("text", x = xB1 + 10, y = L$lr + 0.55, label = L$rtxt, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.1,
             fontface = "bold", colour = L$hex) +
    annotate("text", x = xB1 + 10, y = L$lr - 0.75, label = L$rsub, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.0,
             colour = pal[["ink3"]])
  Lr <- subset(L, lead_r)
  if (nrow(Lr)) p <- p + annotate("segment", x = xB1 + 7, xend = xB1 + 1, y = Lr$lr, yend = Lr$b1,
                                  colour = Lr$hex, linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "13", alpha = 0.6)
  p +
    scale_colour_identity() + scale_linetype_identity() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 650), ylim = c(ybot, ytop), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
    theme_void()
}

leyenda_slope <- function(sp) {
  s <- sp$series; cw <- 0.78
  s$w <- 5.5 + nchar(s$leg) * cw + 4
  x <- 0; r <- 1; s$x <- NA; s$r <- NA
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(s))) {
    if (i > 1 && x + s$w[i] > 100) { r <- r + 1; x <- 0 }
    s$x[i] <- x; s$r[i] <- r; x <- x + s$w[i]
  }
  nr <- max(s$r); s$y <- nr - s$r + 0.5; s$hex <- col_pais[s$id]
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_segment(data = s, aes(x = x, xend = x + 4, y = y, yend = y, colour = hex,
                               linetype = ifelse(dash, "dashed", "solid")), linewidth = 1.3) +
    geom_text(data = s, aes(x = x + 5, y = y, label = leg), hjust = 0, size = 2.3, colour = pal[["ink2"]]) +
    scale_colour_identity() + scale_linetype_identity() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, nr), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") + theme_void()
  attr(p, "filas") <- nr
  p
}

panel_titulo_sl <- function(sp) {
  tt <- paste(strwrap(sp$title, 62), collapse = "\n")
  sub <- paste(strwrap(sp$subtitle, 112), collapse = "\n")
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 1, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, label = tt, size = 4.6, fontface = "bold",
             colour = pal[["ink"]], lineheight = 0.95) +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, label = sub, size = 2.2, colour = pal[["ink2"]], lineheight = 1.0) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, 1), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") + theme_void()
}

panel_nota_sl <- function(sp) {
  txt <- vapply(sp$foot, function(f) paste0(wrap_txt(f$h, 128), "\n", wrap_txt(f$p, 128)), "")
  nl <- sum(n_lines(txt)) + 0.9 * length(txt)
  H <- 0.28 + nl * 0.118
  yy <- H - 0.14
  p <- ggplot() +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 100, ymin = 0, ymax = H, fill = "#FBFBF8", colour = pal[["ink3"]], linewidth = 0.3) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 0.9, ymin = 0, ymax = H, fill = "#B8871E", colour = NA)
  for (i in seq_along(sp$foot)) {
    f <- sp$foot[[i]]; hh <- wrap_txt(f$h, 128); pp <- wrap_txt(f$p, 128)
    p <- p + annotate("text", x = 3, y = yy, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.5, fontface = "bold", colour = pal[["ink"]], label = hh) +
      annotate("text", x = 3, y = yy - 0.14, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.3, lineheight = 1.05, colour = pal[["ink2"]], label = pp)
    yy <- yy - 0.14 - n_lines(pp) * 0.118 - 0.13
  }
  p <- p + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, H), expand = FALSE) + theme_void()
  attr(p, "alto") <- H
  p
}

comparativo <- function(sp, h_main = 4.1) {
  pl <- leyenda_slope(sp); pn <- panel_nota_sl(sp)
  hts <- c(0.62, attr(pl, "filas") * 0.17 + 0.10, h_main, attr(pn, "alto"))
  fig <- (panel_titulo_sl(sp) / pl / panel_slope(sp, h_main) / pn) + plot_layout(heights = hts)
  attr(fig, "alto_total") <- sum(hts)
  fig
}

México no pasa por ese pico en absoluto: a diferencia de los vehículos, las autopartes que califican como originarias bajo el T-MEC (umbrales de 65-75% de RVC según categoría de parte) quedan exentas de la Sección 232 vía la línea arancelaria 9903.94.06 — no hay descuento proporcional por contenido EUA como en vehículos, es exención completa o arancel pleno."),
    list(h = "Panel B — alivio negociado",
         p = "desde ese pico de 25%, Japón, Corea del Sur y la Unión Europea bajan a un techo de 15% en las mismas fechas bilaterales que autos (la cobertura de sus acuerdos incluye autopartes por igual). México se mantiene exento en 0% durante todo el período. No graficado: una autoparte mexicana que no califica bajo el T-MEC paga el 25% pleno sobre el valor total — pero hacia enero de 2026 cerca del 85% de las autopartes mexicanas importadas reclamaban la exención T-MEC, por lo que se omite del gráfico por poco representativa del comercio efectivo.")),
  fuentes = "Federal Register (2025-04-03, 2025-09-25, 2025-12-04) · The White House (2025, O.E. 4 sep.) · GingerControl (s.f.) · International Trade Insights (2025) · BLG (2018)"
)

```

<!-- ========== GUARDAR TODOS LOS GRÁFICOS (PDF + PNG) EN PLOTS/ ========== -->

```{r}
#| label: guardar-graficos
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(here)
dir.create(here::here("PLOTS"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

graficos <- list(
  infografia_mexico       = infografia(spec_mexico),
  infografia_canada       = infografia(spec_canada),
  infografia_china        = infografia(spec_china),
  infografia_corea        = infografia(spec_corea),
  infografia_japon        = infografia(spec_japon),
  infografia_ue           = infografia(spec_ue),
  infografia_vietnam      = infografia(spec_vietnam),
  infografia_taiwan       = infografia(spec_taiwan),
  comparativo_autos       = comparativo(spec_autos),
  comparativo_autopartes  = comparativo(spec_autopartes)
)

for (nm in names(graficos)) {
  g <- graficos[[nm]]
  h <- attr(g, "alto_total")                      # alto calculado de cada figura (pulgadas)
  ggplot2::ggsave(here::here("PLOTS", paste0(nm, ".pdf")), g, width = 6.5, height = h,
                  device = grDevices::cairo_pdf)
  ggplot2::ggsave(here::here("PLOTS", paste0(nm, ".png")), g, width = 6.5, height = h,
                  dpi = 300, device = ragg::agg_png)
}
```
